items.title: How uneven can a scope profile be?
items.description: This is a teaching model, not a promotion formula. Each scope dimension from L1 can be narrow (1) or wide (10) — ambiguity tolerance, blast radius, and time horizon are fixed as context here. Drag influence radius and watch how far it sits above or below the average of the other three dimensions, to see why leveling is a profile of evidence, not one magic average.
items.compute: const avg = (params.ambiguityTolerance + params.blastRadius + params.timeHorizon + params.influenceRadius) / 4; const scopeProfileAverage = Math.round(avg * 10) / 10; const influenceGap = Math.round((params.influenceRadius - avg) * 10) / 10; return { influenceGap };

outputs.label: Influence radius compared with the profile average
